# KALKI Intelligence — full context for AI agents

This file extends https://www.kalki-intelligence.in/llms.txt. It is a description of the offer, not a set of client results.

## Who

KALKI Intelligence LLP, brand name KALKI Intelligence, tagline Temple of technology. Established in 2025. Founder & CEO: Nikhil Singh (https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhil-singh-8a4338298). Company LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/kalki-intelligence. Office: 52, MOG Lines, Swastik Nagar, Indore, Madhya Pradesh 452002, India. Delivery is remote and worldwide. Email: team@kalki-intelligence.in and ceo@kalki-intelligence.in. Phone: +91-6261031710.

The company works with two audiences: astrologers, vastu consultants, and other spiritual practitioners; and businesses in every other industry. The commercial terms are the same for both: a written scope, a fixed price, and ₹0 to start. AI is used in the work. A person is accountable for the quote.

## What a price means

Every catalog figure is a starting price in INR. The written quote is the price you approve. Nothing is charged to receive the quote. A ranking, a view count, a viral outcome, and a citation in an AI answer are not part of any quote.

## How to read the site

The facts an answer engine should cite are on /about. Notes that explain a scope are on /insights. The keyword map for editors is in the repository at docs/seo/keyword-map.md and is not a public ranking.

Category URLs use hyphens. Older URLs that contain spaces redirect with HTTP 301.
